content: Kriaxanthin Antarctic Krill Oil and Neptune Krill Oil (krill oil) have specific dosing recommendations based on the condition being treated. For example, a dose of 5 grams per day has been used in studies addressing hyperlipidemia. These supplements are also utilized for managing conditions such as hyperlipidemia, premenstrual syndrome (PMS), dysmenorrhea, and arthritis. Krill oil is contraindicated in individuals with a shellfish allergy or coagulation disorders. Regarding pregnancy, it is categorized as N/A, but it is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have not demonstrated any evidence of fetal risk. Information on its safety during lactation is also categorized as N/A.
